instruction:
Patch tests/cli/planChecks.examples.test.ts. Replace exactly one test, the one titled "Plan Command example 8: the P10a deck byte for byte on the repository", by one test titled "Plan Command example 8: the repository's own cut speaks contract 3"; keep examples 6 and 7, l1Root, args, ctx, JUDGE_FILE, REPO and every import byte for byte (drop an import only if nothing uses it any more). The new test, in this order:
1. const result = planCommand(REPO, {name: "plan", root: ".", pretty: false, spec: "contour.yaml", components: ["planner", "cli", "cli-plan"], map: "tests/fixtures/cli/p10.map.json", judge: true, out: null, checks: "decks/p10/checks.json"}); expect(result.code).toBe(0); then if (result.code !== 0) throw new Error("unreachable").
2. const document = result.document as PlanDocument; const ids = document.cards.map((c) => c.customId); const loaded = loadDeck(fs.readFileSync(path.join(REPO, "decks/p10/v2deck.json"), "utf8")); if (!loaded.ok) throw; for every card of loaded.deck.cards: expect(ids).toContain(card.customId).
3. PlanDocument has no key proseOnly: read (result.document as unknown as { proseOnly?: string[] }).proseOnly and expect it toStrictEqual ["No Network In Tests", "No Shell Outside Acceptance", "Frozen Tree During Run"].
4. const line = fixture("cli/p33.renderGuard.txt").trimEnd(); const liveGuard = fs.readFileSync(path.join(REPO, "decks/tools/guard.mjs"), "utf8").trimEnd(); expect(liveGuard).toContain("morph-guard-contract: 3"); const render = document.cards.find((c) => c.customId === "render"); its acceptance is string | null: const acceptance = render?.acceptance ?? ""; expect(acceptance).toContain(line); expect(acceptance).toContain(liveGuard).
Never write the guard line itself into the test: it holds backslashes; it comes from the fixture. No test.skip, no vi.mock, no real timers.

The examples below are the criterion, and you are its independent author: write one test per example (no fewer, no merging), each named after the Function and the example number, e.g. "Plan Command example 1".

Data Plan Document: stdout of plan; with --write-probes { spec, components, probes } (the probe paths written).
Schema:
{ spec: string, components: string[], cards: Card[], generations: string[][], externalDependsOn: Record<string, string[]>, out: string | null, proseOnly?: string[], overrides?: string[], warnings?: string[] }

Callee Read Plan Checks: Files of `plan --checks`.
Behaviour: readPlanChecks(root, checksPath, profile = the typescript profile), in order, a failure {ok: false, result}: the file not regular under root → 4 UsageError "checks file not found: <checksPath>"; Parse Document(text, checksPath) error → 2 DeckError, it; Read Checks' problems → 2 DeckError "<checksPath> is not a valid checks document (<n> problem|problems):\n" + them "\n"-joined; GUARD_PATH "decks/tools/guard.mjs", LOCATOR_PATH "decks/tools/firstdiff.mjs" not regular → 4 UsageError "guard|locator file not found: <path>". Probes: per card with files null, <parts>/<builder's probeFile(profile, id)> if regular (go: _<id>_probe_test.go). → {ok: true, checks, texts: {guard, firstdiff, probes}}.

Preconditions a test's setup depends on:
- planner · Cut Component · Validate Record made the record, so every uses name is a declared dependency; a name no dependency carries is simply not found
- planner · Cut Judges · Cut Component made the cuts; an extra card is a Cut Card with component and profile null, functions [] and slicedByMap true
